reading.body:
Oregon's tracked 2026 bills include two AI specific measures, one addressing artificial intelligence generally and a separate bill relating specifically to artificial intelligence companions, alongside a bill on compensation for journalism that likely addresses AI's use of news content, though the data given does not confirm that connection.

Separating a general AI bill from one focused specifically on AI companions suggests Oregon's legislature is treating companion or relationship oriented AI chatbots as a distinct policy category from AI regulation broadly, consistent with growing attention elsewhere to AI companion products specifically.

The remaining bills, on elections, medical assistance, public safety, and medical billing downcoding, along with a memorial resolution for a state senator, are unrelated to AI and make up half of this short eight bill list.

The data does not indicate which of these bills passed, failed, or remain pending, nor does it include bill text beyond title and number, so Oregon's actual AI and AI companion regulations, if enacted, are not established by this record.
